data.name: Queralt
data.gender_notes: Queralt is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Queralt is a name of Catalan origin, derived from the Latin word 'clarus', meaning 'bright' or 'clear'. In Catalan, Queralt translates to 'pure' or 'clear'. This name has a spiritual connotation, symbolizing purity of heart and mind. The name Queralt carries the meaning “Pure, Clear, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Queralt usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Queralt total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
